mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quotes ( content, start_date, end_date, writer_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{request.content}, #{request.startDate}, #{request.endDate}, #{writerId}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT quote_id AS quoteId, content, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, writer_id AS writerId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM quotes ORDER BY quote_id DESC

SELECT quote_id AS quoteId, content, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, writer_id AS writerId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM quotes WHERE CURDATE() BETWEEN start_date AND end_date ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1
